name: Product Performance
title: Product Performance
description: Units, revenue and margin of every product, by category.

parameters.name: year
parameters.label: Year
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM sales ORDER BY 1 DESC

datasets.name: products
datasets.sql: SELECT category, product, sum(quantity) AS units, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue, round(sum(cost)) AS cost FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY category, revenue DESC

datasets.name: best
datasets.sql: SELECT product, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: quarters
datasets.sql: SELECT quarter, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Compute' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Compute, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Networking' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Networking, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Storage' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Storage, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Software' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Software, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Services' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Services, round(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN category = 'Accessories' THEN revenue END), 0)) AS Accessories FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

body.text: {{Format(Sum(units), "#,##0")}} units sold, {{Format(Sum(revenue), "$#,##0")}} revenue, {{Format((Sum(revenue) - Sum(cost)) / Sum(revenue), "0.0%")}} gross margin
